assets.prompt: Create ONE portrait 9:16 cinematic editorial photograph for a Korean consumer explainer about mobile phone plan recommendations. Phone screen has only an abstract mint notification rectangle and simple envelope glyph, absolutely no words, no letters, no numbers. Photoreal art direction, sophisticated financial magazine still life, real glass reflections, tactile metal, soft film grain, hard morning light from upper left, deep forest green shadows and a restrained coral accent on envelope seal. Strong understandable silhouette, NOT tiny toy objects, NOT clay render, NOT stock business illustration, no coins floating, no logos, no watermark. Edge-to-edge full bleed, 1080x1920 composition. This image is part of a coherent six-image series.
